comparison: GraphCL pretraining vs no GraphCL (random init)
fairness_rule: Conditions differ only in encoder weights: GraphCL MolPCBA pretraining vs random initialization. Downstream ProtoNet protocol, architecture, distance, seed, and episode index sets are identical. No encoder training in the No-GraphCL condition.

protocol.rule: Encoder is pretrained only on ogbg-molpcba graphs (labels unused). BACE train/valid are reserved and never used for pretraining or few-shot support/query. Episodes are sampled from BACE test only; within an episode, support and query index sets are disjoint.
